info.title: GitHub Dependency Graph (SBOM)
info.description: GitHub's own resolved dependency graph for a repository, exported as SPDX 2.3. Anonymous for a PUBLIC repository; a private one needs a token with repo scope. The dependency graph must be enabled on the repository — it is on by default for public repos and an organisation setting for private ones.

get.summary: The repository's resolved dependency tree as an SPDX 2.3 SBOM
get.description: Returns `{sbom: {packages: [...]}}`. Each package carries `name`, `versionInfo`, `licenseConcluded`, `SPDXID`, and an `externalRefs` array whose purl entry (`referenceType: purl`) is the package URL — the canonical, ecosystem-qualified identifier that deps.dev and OSV both accept. The FIRST package in the list is the repository itself, not a dependency. Some packages carry no purl (an unresolvable or vendored component); those cannot be looked up anywhere and are dropped.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Repository owner — the org or user login.
